name: pct_multireference_privileged_transport

diagnostics.gate: Continue to training only if correct/correct distances separate from correct/wrong or correct/shuffled, and high-dispersion examples are identifiable.

full_matrix.gate: Run only after the 5k matrix shows PCT gains, especially in high reference-dispersion groups.

paper_claim_gates: Set/PCT methods beat PHF-style single-reference hidden-flow matching on Average@12.
Set/PCT gains are larger on high reference-dispersion problems than low reference-dispersion problems.
FGW or UOT diagnostics improve correct/correct versus correct/wrong or correct/shuffled AUROC over Euclidean matching.
Causal intervention shows valid or nearest-valid flow improves continuation evidence more than mean, wrong, or shuffled flow.
Contamination robustness degrades Mean-PHF faster than set/transport methods, or the paper explicitly reports the failure mode.
